precision: BF16 original weights (pristine digests verified at every load)

prefix_semantics.prefill: one batched causal forward of the 16 x 64 prefixes into a fresh KV cache (no padding, no chat template, no BOS insertion); next-token logits from position 63
prefix_semantics.R: cumulative log-probability includes the teacher-forced prefix transitions 1..63; token 0 contributes 0 (as the historical random first token). Shared by all branches of a sentence, so it never changes a ranking (per-sentence pruning and final selection compare branches of one sentence only)
prefix_semantics.denominator: |S| counts the prefix: score = -(R + log p_v)/(|S|+1) + sigma(S)/tau (audited generator)
prefix_semantics.expert_counts: c_total = c_prefix (all 64 prefix tokens, all 24 layers, top-4) + c_generated
prefix_semantics.first_expansion: one branch per sentence -> the w best of its |V| expansions; afterwards global per-sentence top-w over w x |V|

eos: no stop rule (as historical): special tokens are ordinary candidates; exactly 448 tokens appended
